data.action: 倚栏独坐举盏温酒轻啜
data.description: 【令 · 龙门酒肆独酌】夜幕下的龙门老街酒肆二楼，蓝发如瀑的岁之龙女倚栏独坐，将一盏温酒缓缓举至唇边。龙角在墨青旗袍映衬下泛着幽光，她微微眯起蓝瞳，望着楼下川流的人群轻笑——「千年过去，人间依旧热闹。只是这酒，还是独酌最香。」
data.lighting: warm lantern glow, amber wine reflections, soft window moon
data.promptProse: Upstairs in the Lungmen tavern, Ling rests against the railing and slowly brings warm wine to her lips, her long blue hair draped over an ink-teal qipao. From the slightly low medium angle, retain the carved beams above and the market visitors glimpsed below. A railing post overlaps the nearer end of the tabletop; the upper gallery extends behind her toward the window, while street stalls appear between the balusters. Lantern light warms her cheek, cup and polished wood, with a small reflection beneath the cup. Cooler moonlight from the window catches her horns and the far railing edge, leaving the underside of the gallery subdued.
data.title: 令 · 龙门酒肆独酌
